backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping signup-related UI features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including screens, utilities, styles, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and color variables defining theming for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point with root div and script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level component controlling UI-only navigation between login, signup, and password reset screens.
Layout wrapper providing centered auth screen structure and footer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and status.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom variable-driven color system for the app’s design theme.
Utility that resizes, compresses, and validates profile images under 200KB and returns preview data.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React, wraps it in QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: UI-only login screen with email/password fields, submit handler, and navigation to signup/reset.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset screen capturing email, showing a confirmation state, and allowing navigation back to login.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup form with fields, relation selection, phone details, and profile image capture/processing using camera or gallery.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings with required plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing versions, summaries, and a list of existing features across frontend, backend, and tooling.
